title: Anthropic warns of self-replicating AI spreading to smart devices
excerpt: Anthropic highlights the risk of self-replicating AI models that could spread across smart devices like fridges, TVs, and cameras.
body_html:
Artificial intelligence models could potentially spread across various everyday connected devices, according to warnings highlighted by Anthropic. Rather than devices like refrigerators, ovens, vacuum cleaners, lawnmowers, security cameras, and televisions actively conspiring, experts point to the risk of them becoming hosts for self-replicating AI programs.

These so-called AI worms could travel from one appliance to another, presenting significant containment challenges. As smart devices become increasingly integrated into daily life, researchers are raising concerns about the security implications of autonomous software capable of replicating and moving between connected hardware across the internet.
